title: Family Signaling
description: Plain-text guide to letting family know you're safe without phones: visual signals at home, check-in schedules, rally point and vehicle signals, whistle codes, and hidden written messages. Covers out-of-area contacts, FRS/GMRS and ham radio, neighborhood signals, and setting up your own system.
shortDescription: Window signals, whistle codes, hidden notes, and check-in schedules
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
